source: Calvano, Calzolari, Denicolò & Pastorello (2020) replication package (MIT), AER_fcode/baseline built with gfortran 14; Table I's input with 100 sessions. Per session: periods to convergence excluding the 100 000-period window (the code's timeToConvergence × 25 000), the limit cycle's length and mean profits per firm, and each state's converged prices (0-based grid indices, firm 1 then firm 2, states in the code's order).
